# Blockwork

Blockwork is a parent-approved local marketplace where California teens (ages 13+) earn real paychecks doing outdoor work and online tutoring for neighbors. Every job requires parent approval, every user is identity-verified, and every payment is protected by escrow. Blockwork currently operates in California only.

## Who it's for

- **Teens (13+)**: List services they offer — lawn care, car washing, pet sitting, tech help, online tutoring, and odd jobs — and set their own prices. Teens under 18 need a parent or guardian linked to their account.
- **Parents**: The legal and financial account holder. Parents verify their identity, approve every booking, receive payouts to their connected bank account, and can lock withdrawals at any time.
- **Neighbors**: Browse nearby teen services or post jobs. Pay securely through escrow; confirm the work before payment is released.

## What Blockwork does

- Connects teens with neighbors for outdoor tasks (lawn mowing, yard cleanup, car washing, pet sitting) and online tutoring
- Enforces California child-labor laws automatically at booking time (age minimums, daily/weekly hour limits, prohibited time windows)
- Holds payments in escrow via Stripe until both sides confirm the job is complete
- Pays out earnings to the parent's Stripe Connect account (never directly to a minor)
- Screens all listings for safety hazards before they go live

## What Blockwork does NOT do

- Teens never enter a client's home — all in-person work is outdoors, all tutoring is over video
- Blockwork never stores card numbers, bank details, or Social Security numbers (all handled by Stripe)
- No childcare, transportation, heavy machinery, or hazardous work is permitted

## Pricing

- Free to join and free to list
- 12.9% + $0.30 platform fee per completed job (deducted from the total the neighbor pays)
- Tips are optional, processed separately with a 3.5% + $0.50 fee
- No signup fees, subscriptions, or listing fees
